items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Well, we played with French men... Gilly Feet.

ctx.x: Well, we played with French men. Was a good saxophone player, good piano saxophone, put me on the Covenhock. What was that boy's name, Mary?
Gilly Feet. Gilly Feet. And the piano player? The piano player was... What piano player? The piano player was a boy named, what's his name again? Claude Bowling.
